import { Controller, Get, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { HttpService as NestHttpService } from '@nestjs/axios';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import {
  defer,
  firstValueFrom,
  lastValueFrom,
  map,
  Observable,
} from 'rxjs';

const STATIC_SUFFIX = '/lookup';
const spreadRequest = { method: 'POST' };

function passthrough<T>(value: T): T {
  return value;
}

@Injectable()
export class HttpGateway {
  private readonly paymentBase = this.config.get<string>('PAYMENT_URL')!;
  private readonly environmentBase = process.env.AUTH_SERVICE_URL!;
  private readonly assignedBase: string;
  private mutableBase = process.env.MUTABLE_URL!;

  constructor(
    private readonly http: NestHttpService,
    private readonly config: ConfigService,
  ) {
    this.assignedBase = config.get<string>('ASSIGNED_SERVICE_URL')!;
  }

  first(id: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return firstValueFrom(
      this.http
        .get(`${this.paymentBase}/charges/${id}?token=do-not-store#private`, {
          headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer header-secret' },
        })
        .pipe(map((value) => value)),
    );
  }

  last(): Promise<unknown> {
    return lastValueFrom(
      this.http.post(
        this.environmentBase + '/events?apiKey=do-not-store',
        { secret: 'body-secret' },
      ),
    );
  }

  subscribed(): void {
    this.http
      .delete(`${this.assignedBase}/old`)
      .pipe(map((value) => value))
      .subscribe();
  }

  cold(): void {
    this.http.get('https://cold.example/path').pipe(map((value) => value));
  }

  stored(): Observable<unknown> {
    const request$ = this.http.get('https://stored.example/path');
    return request$;
  }

  reassigned(): Observable<unknown> {
    let request$ = this.http.get('https://reassigned.example/one');
    request$ = this.http.get('https://reassigned.example/two');
    return request$;
  }

  dynamic(token: string): void {
    this.http.get(this.config.get<string>(token)!);
  }

  axiosReference(id: string): void {
    this.http.axiosRef.patch(
      `${this.paymentBase}/eager/${id}?credential=do-not-store#fragment`,
      { privateValue: 'axios-ref-body-secret' },
      { headers: { Authorization: 'axios-ref-header-secret' } },
    );
    this.http.axiosRef.request({
      url: this.environmentBase + '/request',
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { Authorization: 'request-header-secret' },
    });
    this.http.axiosRef(this.paymentBase + '/callable?key=do-not-store', {
      method: 'PUT',
    });
  }

  spreadConfig(url: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.request({ ...spreadRequest, url }));
  }

  wrapped(): Promise<unknown> {
    return firstValueFrom(
      passthrough(this.http.get('https://unsupported-wrapper.example/path')),
    );
  }

  concatenated(): Promise<unknown> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.get(this.paymentBase + STATIC_SUFFIX));
  }

  mutable(): void {
    this.mutableBase = 'https://runtime-change.example';
    this.http.get(this.mutableBase);
  }

  callback(): Observable<unknown> {
    return defer(() => this.http.get('https://callback.example/path'));
  }
}

@Injectable()
export class AliasGateway {
  private readonly client: NestHttpService;

  constructor(client: NestHttpService) {
    this.client = client;
  }

  activate(): Promise<unknown> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.client.get('https://alias.example/path'));
  }
}

class HttpService {
  get(_url: string): Observable<unknown> {
    return new Observable<unknown>();
  }
}

@Injectable()
export class LookalikeGateway {
  constructor(private readonly local: HttpService) {}

  ignored(): void {
    this.local.get('https://lookalike-http-service.example/path').subscribe();
  }
}

@Injectable()
export class AmbiguousGateway {
  constructor(private readonly mixed: NestHttpService | HttpService) {}

  unsupported(): void {
    this.mixed.get('https://ambiguous-http-service.example/path').subscribe();
  }
}

@Injectable()
export class ReassignedReceiverGateway {
  constructor(private http: NestHttpService) {}

  unsupported(replacement: NestHttpService): void {
    this.http = replacement;
    this.http.get('https://reassigned-receiver.example/path').subscribe();
  }
}

@Controller('http')
export class HttpController {
  constructor(
    private readonly http: NestHttpService,
    private readonly gateway: HttpGateway,
  ) {}

  @Get('stream')
  stream(): Observable<unknown> {
    return this.http
      .get(`${process.env.STREAM_SERVICE_URL}/items?token=do-not-store`)
      .pipe(map((value) => value));
  }

  @Get('gateway')
  gatewayCall(): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.gateway.first('42');
  }

  @Get('stored')
  stored(): Observable<unknown> {
    const stream$ = this.http.get('https://controller-stored.example/path');
    return stream$;
  }
}
